# Yuitility

> [Yuitility](https://www.yuitility.app) is a 100% private, free online browser-based toolkit offering 132 client-side utilities and calculators for financial math, PDF operations, image conversion, developer encoding, health metrics, and construction estimators. All processing runs entirely in client-side WebAssembly and JavaScript memory with zero server uploads, no accounts, and no tracking.

## Core Platform
- [Home & Tool Catalog](https://www.yuitility.app/): Interactive catalog of all 132 browser-based tools and calculators.
- [Complete Tool Directory](https://www.yuitility.app/tools): Single-page listing of every tool across all categories.
- [Full LLM Specification](https://www.yuitility.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive API and schema directory for AI agents.
- [About Yuitility](https://www.yuitility.app/about): Privacy policy, architecture, and client-side computing philosophy.
- [Blog & Guides](https://www.yuitility.app/blog): Engineering deep-dives, calculator tutorials, and privacy guides.

## Tool Categories
- [Finance & Wealth Calculators](https://www.yuitility.app/category/finance): EMI, loan repayment, SIP, SWP, salary take-home, income tax, EPF, PPF, NPS, GST, and investment analytics.
- [Calculators & Mathematics](https://www.yuitility.app/category/math): Standard, scientific, mean, median, percentage, GPA/CGPA, matrix, and probability calculators.
- [PDF & Document Utilities](https://www.yuitility.app/category/pdf): In-browser client-side PDF merging, splitting, compressing, watermarking, metadata editing, and rotation.
- [Developer Utilities](https://www.yuitility.app/category/developer): JSON formatter, Regex tester, UUID generator, Base64 encoder, URL encoder, Hash generator, and text diff checker.
- [Image & Media Tools](https://www.yuitility.app/category/media): Browser-based image compressor, resizer, background remover, format converter, and meme maker.
- [Utility & Construction](https://www.yuitility.app/category/utility): Room square footage, flooring, brick count, paint estimator, concrete volume, and everyday unit converters.

## Popular Tools
- [EMI Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/emi-calculator): Calculate monthly EMI, principal-to-interest breakdown, and amortization schedule.
- [SIP Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/sip-calculator): Mutual fund systematic investment plan return and wealth projection calculator.
- [Age Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/age-calculator): Exact age calculation down to years, months, days, hours, and next birthday countdown.
- [Salary Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/salary-calculator): Monthly in-hand salary estimator calculating EPF, professional tax, and income tax deductions.
- [PDF Merger](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/pdf-merger): Fast, 100% private in-browser tool to combine multiple PDF files into one.
- [PDF Splitter](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/pdf-splitter): Extract pages or split PDF documents locally without uploading to external servers.
- [Image Compressor](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/image-compressor): Client-side image compression reducing PNG, JPEG, and WebP file sizes.
- [Background Remover](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/background-remover): Client-side AI background removal using in-browser WebAssembly.
- [JSON Formatter](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/json-formatter): Validate, beautify, minify, and inspect JSON data structures in memory.
- [Password Generator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/password-generator): Cryptographically secure random password and passphrase generator using Web Crypto API.
- [QR Code Generator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/qr-code-generator): Create high-resolution custom QR codes for URLs, WiFi, contact cards, and text.
- [Word Counter](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/word-counter): Real-time word, character, sentence, paragraph, and reading time counter.
- [Unit Converter](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/unit-converter): Universal converter for length, weight, volume, temperature, and speed.
- [Standard Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/standard-calculator): Clean, instant basic arithmetic calculator with memory register and history.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/scientific-calculator): Full-featured scientific calculator with trigonometric, logarithmic, and exponential operations.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/income-tax-calculator): Compare Old vs New tax regimes with accurate slab deductions.
- [GST Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/gst-calculator): Inclusive and exclusive goods and services tax calculator.
- [PPF Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/ppf-calculator): Public Provident Fund maturity and interest accumulation calculator.
- [FD Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/fd-calculator): Fixed deposit maturity amount and compounded interest returns.
- [RD Calculator](https://www.yuitility.app/tools/rd-calculator): Recurring deposit future value and total interest estimator.
